RAG-6cead041c181641b.quote: At a scheduled commercial-driver medical, the driver answers questions in several stages because a dispatcher keeps calling about the next route, while the nurse checks a current clinical document against a copied workplace summary; an observation described confidently in conversation is kept separate from a finding actually recorded in an identified examination.
